scope: Final review group: private/public share metadata and image boundaries, resilient image wrapper and calendar-duration helpers
reviewExtent: Full current bodies of helpers/image routes/private and shared layouts read; homepage entire base-to-current semantic diff reread separately after initial combined output truncation. API/date deletion read from base and remaining consumers traced to distinct date-range helper.

deletion.consumerCheck: No exact old-module consumer; references found are lib/api/date-range, a distinct retained helper

invariants: Failed marketing/blog cover uses packaged illustrated fallback and accurate fallback alt; changed src resets failure selection
Social image text is whitespace-normalized and bounded by Unicode codepoints; no user-provided file path or remote-image fetch
Only public font buffers are globally cached; failed font read resets promise; image routes run Node with traced fonts
Private metadata and image reads require verified account and owner filter; private page metadata remains noindex; images explicitly private/no-store
Shared reads require valid token syntax and is_shared=true; only selected trip/itinerary fields read; no owner ID in projection
Shared lookup errors differ from absent/revoked rows; malformed itinerary envelope throws recoverable read failure instead of an empty plan
React cache is request-scoped; shared images read token/flag freshly with revalidate0 and private/no-store
JSON-LD escapes less-than characters, retains valid calendar-date values and omits invalid date fields
Calendar-day duration is inclusive and independent of DST; date-only database values parse as local calendar dates
Homepage main landmark excludes header/footer; resilience substitutions preserve image sizing/layout and truthful illustration labels

findings.deferred: Status-aware private metadata wording for saved drafts/failed planning; no user journey blocked

limits: Hosted revocation/JWT/RLS/data lifecycle and image availability remain external
This review does not prove signed native binary/on-device UI or all changed files reviewed
